matrices: (select o,d,value,timestamp from mat_car where scenario_id={scenario_id} and timestamp>={t_start} and timestamp<{t_end}) mat
(select o,d,value,timestamp from mat_heavy where scenario_id={scenario_id} and timestamp>={t_start} and timestamp<{t_end}) mat

params.zones: (select id, st_astext(geom) as geometry from zones where scenario_id={scenario_id}) zones

supply.links: (select id, from_node, to_node, v0, connector, lanes, alpha, rcr, capacity, length, modes, st_astext(geom) as geometry from links where scenario_id={scenario_id}) links
supply.nodes: (select id, modes, st_astext(geom) as geometry from nodes where scenario_id={scenario_id}) nodes
supply.turns: (select from_node, via_node, to_node, modes, penalty from turns where scenario_id={scenario_id}) turns

links_sets: (select id_set, id_link from links_sets where scenario_id={scenario_id}) links_sets
events: (select id_link_set, type, start, end, params from events where scenario_id={scenario_id}) events
detectors: (select id, id_link from detectors where scenario_id={scenario_id}) detectors
traffic_lights: (select id, cycle, offset, phases from traffic_lights where scenario_id={scenario_id}) traffic_lights
